about: guidegen: how a made video is cut into a battle clip, by kind of animation. These are the numbers wanch1 and clipch1 settled (the stamps in data/clips/*.js show them: 'wan-gen tom-idle rev 1; 0 to 147 step 3, loop wrap'). Read by tools/guidegen/build_map.js (the recipe name of each animation) and tools/guidegen/make_take.py and use_take.py (the bake). step counts pictures of a 30 a second video; speed is the game's playback speed; marks says how the first and last picture (and the hit, or the guard's rise and lowering) are found from the video itself.

idle.says: the whole video, every 3rd picture, played forward only

run.says: one stride cycle, every 2nd picture, played forward only

guard.says: the rise once, the held stretch back and forth, the lowering once

strike.says: the move with its hit, every 3rd picture, 1.5x

strike1x.says: the move with its hit, every 3rd picture, 1x

windup.says: the wind-up, held at its end, every 2nd picture, 1.5x
